newsitem.title: USA: Continental changes New York ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: Continental changes New York ad campaign.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said Tuesday it would launch a new and modified advertising campaign promoting its service from Newark International Airport in New Jersey in the next few weeks.

The airline said in a statement that it resolved concerns raised by New York City mayor Rudolph Giuliani about the campaign, which urged travelers to fly from Newark instead of New York's Kennedy and LaGuardia airports.
The mayor had objected to the campaign, saying on June 24 "the ads are largely negative and disparaging of the city of New York." He urged airline to drop the ads immediately.
Continental suspended its ad campaign June 25, eight days after it started.
